# Rust supplier contract (reference crate)

The FRB contract crate lives at `packages/content_suppliers_rust/rust` (+ `flutter_rust_bridge.yaml`).
It is the **source of truth** for the FFI contract between the app and the external supplier modules
(`strumok_suppliers` 5.x). See [spec-02-content-suppliers-ffi](../../../../docs/specs/spec-02-content-suppliers-ffi.md).

```text
packages/content_suppliers_rust/
├── flutter_rust_bridge.yaml      rust_input: crate::api, rust_root: rust/, dart_output: lib/rust
└── rust/
    ├── Cargo.toml                flutter_rust_bridge = "=2.13.0", crate-type cdylib+staticlib
    ├── Cargo.lock
    └── src/
        ├── lib.rs
        ├── api/mod.rs            ◀ CONTRACT: exported functions (funcId order is derived from here)
        ├── models.rs             ◀ CONTRACT: transferred types
        ├── frb_generated.rs      generated by FRB 2.13.0 (content hash -1122641696)
        └── suppliers/
            ├── mod.rs            ContentSupplier / MangaPagesLoader traits, enum dispatch, registry
            └── dummy.rs          test supplier "dummy" (ignored by FRB)
```

## Invariants

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| FRB codegen | `2.13.0` |
| `FLUTTER_RUST_BRIDGE_CODEGEN_CONTENT_HASH` | `-1122641696` (derived from the codegen config; unchanged by the API-5 field additions) |
| Compatible bundle major | `5` |
| sha256 `rust/src/api/mod.rs` | `ac26e23fdd971a43388001d8f429b247073c95f2440f968cad1488a71013b69b` |
| sha256 `rust/src/models.rs` | `92b933ca3ad6a84b5f0f0c06c46007e6e2223366198286ae20e71c355d25668d` |
| sha256 `rust/src/frb_generated.rs` | `5d8ac6bf776496e1979397e7761244bf17b65c22aaacaf00e8e4010af56e9a9f` |

Verify in the new repo:

```bash
cd packages/content_suppliers_rust
sha256sum rust/src/api/mod.rs rust/src/models.rs rust/src/frb_generated.rs
grep -n "CONTENT_HASH: i32 = -1122641696" rust/src/frb_generated.rs
```

## API 5 change (language field)

API major `5` adds an optional `language: Option<String>` field to every `ContentMediaItemSource` variant
(`Video`, `Subtitle`, `Manga`) in `models.rs`; the Dart side maps it to `ContentLanguage?`. The wire layout of
these variants therefore changed, so the app rejects API-4 bundles via `compatibleApiVersion` (bundle
`version.major` must equal `5`). The FRB content hash is derived from the codegen config, not the model surface,
so it stays `-1122641696`; the `compatibleApiVersion` gate — not the hash — is what blocks incompatible bundles.
Any further `api`/`models` change must bump the major again, coordinated with the `strumok_suppliers` repo.

## Rules

- **Do not casually modify** `api/mod.rs`, `models.rs` or `frb_generated.rs`. Changing names, argument order, types,
  enum variants or field order changes the wire layout (and/or `funcId`s) and published modules of the old major will
  not load. Such a change is only allowed as a coordinated bundle-major bump (as done for API 5) with the
  `strumok_suppliers` repo and a matching `compatibleApiVersion`.
- The external modules (separate `strumok_suppliers` repo) implement the same `api` and `models`;
  `suppliers/` here only contains the `dummy` supplier for tests.
- After a deliberate contract change, regenerate the Dart bindings (`lib/rust/*.dart`) with the pinned FRB codegen,
  update `lib/bundle.dart`'s `compatibleApiVersion`, and keep `content_suppliers_api` in sync.

## Building the dummy library (for the FFI smoke test)

```bash
cd packages/content_suppliers_rust/rust
cargo build --release          # → target/release/libcontent_suppliers_rust.so (Linux) / content_suppliers_rust.dll
```

Note: `dummy.rs` is excluded from FRB codegen (`flutter_rust_bridge:ignore`), so the content hash is unaffected
by its contents. It builds a `Video`/`Subtitle`/`Manga` source for each kind (including the API-5 `language`
field) so the smoke test can exercise the full surface.
